GHA.note: Traders demand an audit and cite Act 891, but the article states no AI rule, authority or enforcement decision.
The AI tool named is a customs valuation system, which belongs to the sector study.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance and Ghana Revenue Authority said Publican Trade Solution, an AI-based tool helping customs officers value and classify imports, was fully rolled out at ports of entry on 11 March 2026 beside ICUMS.

The Ministry of Finance said that since its introduction on 11 March 2026 Publican Trade Solution had endorsed clearing of 75.3 percent of customs declarations and flagged 24.7 percent as below accepted global values.

systems.owner: Ministry of Finance / Ghana Revenue Authority

GHA.note: Publican is a supplier's product; no local AI development is stated.

facts.fact: Graphic Online reports ICUMS is the main interface used for declarations, classification, valuation and clearing of goods at Ghana's ports of entry.

GHA.note: Traders complain the Publican rollout lacked consultation, but it is a customs system, not a named digital law or policy.
